text:
The user provided a specific set of constraints:
1. Assign the questions to one of the four provided categories.
2. Refrain from uttering any extraneous words.
3. List only one topic per sentence.
4. Strictly adhere to a line-by-line format.

Assistant A followed every instruction perfectly. It identified the categories and provided them in a clean, line-by-line format without any extra text.

Assistant B failed on almost every constraint. It provided long, rambling summaries of the topics instead of just assigning the category, included extraneous words, and failed to follow the requested format.

[[A]]
